GLS.feature.pf2e-arcane-surge.title: PF2e Arcane Surge
GLS.feature.pf2e-arcane-surge.hint: Eligible spells roll a bespoke d20 against the area's stability. A surge banners the spell's card, tears the screen, and posts a severity card for the GM or the caster to roll.

levelHint.stable: Land held securely by stabilizing divine power. Magic behaves.
levelHint.fraying: Near the Sea of Stars, or an island whose divine stabilization has weakened.
levelHint.unbound: Sailing the Sea, an island without stabilizing power, or a bleed zone.
levelHint.unraveling: Particularly unstable ocean, a severe bleed zone, or instability deliberately intensified.

tierHint.minor: The spell resolves normally against its intended targets. One consequential addition, burden, exposure or local hazard — never merely cosmetic.
tierHint.major: The spell's recognizable purpose survives. Delivery, targets, reach, duration and collateral effects can change substantially.
tierHint.catastrophic: Reality misreads the intention. A meaningful magical event related to the spell, but the intended benefit is not guaranteed.
tierHint.breach: The Sea overwhelms the casting. An event capable of changing a journey, an island, or the campaign.

hud.gmHint: Click to set the area's stability.

arm.steadied: Steady the Spell — one extra action, one step safer for this casting.
arm.invited: Invite the Surge — no extra action, a guaranteed surge on a worse row.

conceal.name: Conceal stability from players
conceal.hint: Hides the chip and the ambient overlay from players. The mechanics keep running — a surge still fires and still animates.

ambient.name: Ambient instability overlay
ambient.hint: The full-screen veil that thickens as stability worsens. Turn it off to save frames; the chip stays either way.

dieVisibility.name: Show the surge die
dieVisibility.hint: When the 3D surge die is thrown for your own eligible castings.

config.title: Arcane Surge — Odds & Eligibility
config.menuHint: Surge thresholds, severity bands, and which castings are eligible.
config.intro: The four stability levels are fixed; every number below is yours. A level's surge threshold is also the number of glyph faces on its die, so raising it makes the die visibly more dangerous.
config.thresholdHint: A casting surges when the d20 rolls at or under this number. Stable never rolls.
config.bandsHint: Cumulative upper bounds on a d100. A tier sharing a bound with the one above it has no window and never comes up — which is how Fraying reaches Major but never Catastrophic.

eligibilityHint.cantrips: Off by default — a cantrip is excluded even when it is a focus cantrip or comes from an item.
eligibilityHint.innate: Innate spells from ancestry, items or effects.
eligibilityHint.fromItems: Scrolls, wands and staves — spells actually cast, not activated abilities.
eligibilityHint.rituals: Off by default — the draft leaves rituals to separate GM adjudication.
eligibilityHint.npcCasters: On by default. NPC surges roll privately to the GM and wait to be released.

config.minRankHint: Castings below this rank are never checked.
